captures.primary: Initial owned scratch-org capture; all API62 anonymous cells and API62 named S00-S09.
captures.recovery: Replacement owned scratch-org capture; remaining API62 named cells and all API67/68 cells. Merged successful retries retain their native marker hashes.

provenance.clock: Each cell runs at its captured now in its captured running-user time zone; before and after values are asserted literally. Anonymous after is not-applicable.
provenance.anonymousCleanup: The native anonymous wrapper calls System.abortJob after its snapshot. Replay omits this cleanup in a disposable VM. Successful anonymous complete=true is retained as a partial carry, not asserted; all cron snapshot fields are asserted.
provenance.scope: Only scheduling rows are exported; unrelated string, query and temporal-cast rows belong to their own families.

helpers.ClockJobFixture: public class ClockJobFixture implements Schedulable {public void execute(SchedulableContext context){} }
helpers.SnapshotSeed: public class SnapshotSeed {public static Map<String,Object> get(String key){CronTrigger c=[SELECT CronExpression,State,TimesTriggered,NextFireTime FROM CronTrigger WHERE Id=:key];Map<String,Object> x=new Map<String,Object>{'state'=>c.State,'times'=>c.TimesTriggered,'next'=>c.NextFireTime,'null'=>c.NextFireTime==null};if(c.NextFireTime!=null){x.put('utc',c.NextFireTime.formatGmt('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'));x.put('local',c.NextFireTime.format('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'));}try{x.put('minute',c.NextFireTime.minute());}catch(Exception e){x.put('type',e.getTypeName());x.put('message',e.getMessage());}return x;} }
